name: Roses and Thorns
source:
Lost, alone and on the verge of frostbite, you travel through the ferocious French Alps in search of refuge and help. After a sudden blizzard and a brush of death, you wake up in a strange new place. A castle of some sorts, filled with warm fires and calming isolation. That is until you meet the owner of the strange castle. An eccentric yet charming man by the name of Viktor who offers you a place to stay while the freezing blizzards rages on .

Finally, a friendly face after so many months of being alone.

A kind and patient new companion .

Yet you remind him of someone. Someone he knew a long time ago.

And he won't let you leave any time soon.

[Edited from [url=https://lunarmoonstudios.itch.io/roses-have-thorns]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你迷失了方向，孤身一人，濒临冻伤，穿越凶猛的法国阿尔卑斯山，寻找避难所和帮助。在一场突如其来的暴风雪和一阵死亡之后，你在一个陌生的新地方醒来。一座某种城堡，充满了温暖的火焰和平静的隔离。直到你遇到了这座奇怪城堡的主人。一个名叫维克托的古怪而迷人的男人，在冰冷的暴风雪肆虐期间为你提供一个住宿的地方。

经过几个月的独处之后，终于有了一张友善的面孔。

一个善良而耐心的新伙伴。

但你却让他想起了一个人。一个他很久以前就认识的人。

而且他不会让你很快离开。

[编辑自[url=https://lunarmoonstudios.itch.io/roses-have-thorns]itch.io[/url]]
